journey.name: ST-02 A first load that fails becomes the screen
journey.description:
Covers FR-09. REQUIREMENTS.md section 9, precedence 2: a failure with nothing cached is a full-screen typed message plus Retry, never a snackbar.
The wording comes from core_ui_error_network and must match exactly. DataError carries no strings, so a change here is a change in :core:ui, not in the data layer.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 1.0

actions.action: Verify that "No connection. Check your network and try again." is on screen
Verify that a "Retry" button is on screen
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is not on screen
Verify that an element with the content description "Add task" is still on screen
Verify that "Search by title" is not on screen
Verify that no element with the content description "Sort tasks" is on screen
